extraction_notes: Zener curve points are digitized from the plotted 18B curve on p. 3; no points were interpolated between plotted readings.
The datasheet publishes zener impedance but the extraction schema has no zener-impedance field, so it is not represented as a spec field.
No junction-capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published for this family.
